title: Validate damage requests from clients
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a DamageGuard class for the server. `DamageGuard.new()`.
`:allow(player: Player, target: any, amount: any, now: number): boolean` decides whether a damage request a client
sent is allowed. Allow only if: amount is a finite number with 0 < amount <= 25; target is a Model with a Humanoid
whose Health > 0; target is not the player's own character; the target's PrimaryPart (or HumanoidRootPart) is within
15 studs of the player's HumanoidRootPart; and the player's last allowed request was at least 0.5 s before `now`
(per player). Refused requests do not count for the rate limit. It never errors on bad input.
